findings.note: Exact UPC resolves to a true 4K UHD short-throw gaming projector: 3840x2160, 3,600 lumens, lamp light source. Verify lamp hours, optics, remote and completeness before setting a final max bid.
Model resolution shows native 1920x1080 with 3840x2160 input/support. Useful budget smart projector candidate, but it should not rank in the native-4K hunt beside the Optoma.

Identity resolves to a 45-inch 800R curved OLED WQHD 240Hz gaming monitor. High-value fit for the large gaming-monitor lane, but panel damage, burn-in and missing-stand risk deserve a larger open-box discount.
Verified as the 32-inch Odyssey G55C, 2560x1440, 165Hz, 1000R curved. Keep it in Curved Monitors, but suppress it from the 34-inch-plus Large Gaming Monitor intent.
Verified as a 27-inch 4K QD-OLED, 240Hz G81SF. Very interesting tech candidate, but it does not satisfy the large-monitor size intent and is therefore suppressed from that lane.
ASIN resolves to the 27-inch S2722DGM QHD 165Hz curved gaming monitor. Keep it in Curved Monitors, but it does not satisfy the 34-inch-plus large-monitor preference.

The ASIN resolves to Klipsch The Three Plus (model 1064667), not the One II named in the MAC.BID title. Treat the ASIN/model identity as the stronger pricing reference and verify the physical label/photo before bidding.

The Tapo C210 family supports local RTSP/ONVIF, making it a strong Home Assistant candidate through the ONVIF integration. Confirm exact pack/model, factory reset and local-stream availability on the auction units.
U300 is a Matter-over-Thread smart lock and is a strong Home Assistant fit through Matter. Verify factory reset, Thread/Matter commissioning state and hardware completeness before bidding.
Schlage Connect exists in multiple radio variants. Confirm the exact Z-Wave/Zigbee model from label/model number before calling it HAOS-compatible; a Z-Wave variant is the preferred local fit.

Real tablet candidate, but current bidder competition is materially higher than many tools/home items. Keep it in the tech watch lane and let verified street price plus all-in auction cost decide whether the spread survives.

Good tool/resale-shaped candidate because it can combine useful personal value, local pickup economics and low competition. Exact model, included fence/guard/blade hardware and real market value still need verification.
